chunks: And whatever is in it from Muthannā ibn ʿAbd al-Salām, I have narrated it from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan—may Allah be pleased with him—from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan al-Ṣaffār, from Muʿāwiyah ibn Ḥakīm, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn al-Mughīrah, from Muthannā ibn ʿAbd al-Salām.

key_terms.الصَّفَّارِ: Part of the named chain of transmission in this sanad
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I narrated it; indicates direct transmission by the compiler through intermediaries
key_terms.عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ: A transmitter in the documented sanad
key_terms.مُثَنّٰى بْنِ عَبْدِ السَّلَامِ: A transmitter whose chain is being clarified here

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Muthannā ibn ʿAbd al-Salām in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from Muthannā ibn ʿAbd al-Salām. Its significance lies in documenting the chain of transmission in hadith literature and identifying the intermediaries relied upon by the compiler.
